description: This file defines a React component named `MindmapFiltersBar` which provides a user interface for filtering features in a mindmap visualization, including salary range, skill similarity, and time horizon. It includes UI elements such as sliders and select dropdowns and manages state updates via callback functions.

methods.name: MindmapFiltersBar
methods.description: React functional component that renders a filter bar with sliders and dropdowns to filter a mindmap visualization based on salary, skill similarity, and time horizon.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Updates the salary range filters based on the slider values.

methods.name: setSimilarity
methods.description: Updates the skill similarity filter based on the slider value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all filters to default values.
